title: next lists a task as ready while its parent story waits on an unfinished depends_on
goal: backlog.py next, horizon and claim treat an item as waiting while any ancestor story or bug has a depends_on item that is not done, with a planted failure in test_backlog.py; the runbook's depends_on line says so

run: import json,pathlib,subprocess,sys;I={p.stem:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in pathlib.Path('kb/_self/backlog').glob('*.json')};A=lambda i:[I[i]['parent']]+A(I[i]['parent']) if I.get(i,{}).get('parent') in I else [];o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','next','--any','--all'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.split();b=[i for i in o if i in I for p in A(i) if any(I.get(d,{}).get('status')!='done' for d in I[p].get('depends_on',[]))];print(b);sys.exit(bool(b))
